notes: Darwin's 'Edentata (armadilloes, scaly ant-eaters, etc.)' is the obsolete order uniting Xenarthra and Pholidota; GBIF keeps it as a synonym usage.
resolution_notes: GBIF usage 11034550 has taxonomicStatus SYNONYM (accepted: Pilosa, key 1494).
NCBI Taxonomy has no Edentata (obsolete grouping).
